name: SAMOA

flag.title: Flag of Samoa
flag.note: Red & blue with Southern Cross stars

lead: Samoa is a small island country in the South Pacific. It has two volcanic islands ringed by reefs and rainforest. People settled here 3,000 years ago. Samoa gave the world the word "tattoo".

sections.wows: 7 things to make you go wow

geo: Samoa has two volcanic islands. The bigger one, Savai'i, has huge fields of hard lava from a 1905 eruption. Rainforest covers the mountains. White beaches and reefs line the coast.
To Sua Ocean Trench is a swimming hole 30 metres deep. A collapsed lava tunnel made it. An underwater cave joins it to the sea.
animals: Samoa's only native land mammals are bats. One, the Samoan flying fox, hunts fruit in daylight and spreads seeds. Sea turtles nest on quiet beaches.
The manumea, or tooth-billed pigeon, is Samoa's national bird. Fewer than 250 survive. Over 84% of Samoa's birds live nowhere else on Earth.
culture: Fa'a Samoa means the Samoan Way. Big families share open-walled houses called fale. Before a ceremony, elders share a drink called 'ava from a coconut shell.
Young men get the pe'a, a tattoo from waist to knee. Music, dance and weaving fine mats are key arts. Sunday is a day of rest.
history: Polynesians (Pacific islanders) sailed here from Tonga around 1000 BCE. By 200 CE, Samoa launched voyages that settled Hawaii and New Zealand. British missionaries (religious teachers) arrived in 1830.
Germany and the US split the islands in 1899. New Zealand took over in 1914. On 1 January 1962, Samoa became the first Pacific island nation to win full independence.
wows: Samoa skipped 30 December 2011 by jumping across the Date Line, where the day changes.
The word 'tattoo' comes from the Samoan word tatau.
In 2009, Samoa switched overnight from driving on the right to the left.
A 30-minute flight from Samoa to American Samoa takes you back to 'yesterday'.
Scientists went five years without photographing a live, rare manumea pigeon.
Samoa has no army, one of only 21 such countries.
Samoan flying foxes (fruit bats) hunt fruit in daylight, unusual for a bat.

myths.myth: Samoa and American Samoa are one country
myths.fact: No. American Samoa is a US territory, 164 km away. It uses the US dollar.

myths.myth: A Samoan tattoo is made with a machine
myths.fact: Artists tap the ink in by hand with a bone comb. A full pe'a takes weeks.
